title: Turn off two-factor | Bobbin
headings: Locked out?Let's get you back in.
bodyText: Locked out? Let's get you back in. Confirm the reset your administrator asked for, then sign in with your password. Turn off two-factor authentication? An administrator asked to turn off two-factor authentication on your account, so you can log in with your password alone. Only confirm if you asked them to. Turn off two-factor Didn't ask for this? Ignore this page and tell your administrator. Nothing changes unless you confirm.
